mapper.select: SELECT a.id as activityId, a.title as activityTitle, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(am.user_id) FROM biz_activity_member am WHERE am.activity_id = a.id AND am.type = 1 AND am.status = 1 AND am.deleted = 0 ) as speakerUserId, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(am.user_id) FROM biz_activity_member am WHERE am.activity_id = a.id AND am.type = 2 AND am.status = 1 AND am.deleted = 0 ) as requireUserId, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(am.user_id) FROM biz_activity_member am WHERE am.activity_id = a.id AND am.type = 3 AND am.status = 1 AND am.deleted = 0 ) as normalUserId FROM biz_activity a WHERE a.deleted = 0 ${ew.customSqlSegment} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(am.activity_id) as activityCount, GROUP_CONCAT(am.activity_id SEPARATOR ',') as activityIds FROM biz_activity_member am WHERE am.user_id = #{userId} AND am.status = 1 AND am.deleted = 0
